name: sgs/media
title: SGS Media
description: Content media block — image or video. Use mediaType to choose image (with imageUrl) or video (with videoUrl for external embeds or videoId for WP-library uploads). Media sizing/shape/border (aspect ratio, height/width, max-width/height, named shape, border width/style/colour/radius) and overlay/video-behaviour are driven by the shared media-atom layer (box-shape/overlay/video-behaviour, Wave 5b 2026-09-01) — supports.filter.duotone (T3.5, D402 ADOPT) is a separate native WP support, rendered as a generated class + <style> tag, needing no render.php involvement.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Wave 5b (2026-09-01). box-shape/video-behaviour/overlay are now wired, closing the Wave 5a gap list. `box-shape` REPLACES this block's old native `__experimentalBorder` (width/style/colour/radius) AND the old native `supports.dimensions.aspectRatio` — the atom's own borderRadius/borderRadiusTablet/borderRadiusMobile/borderWidth/borderStyle/borderColour/borderColourGradient/aspectRatio/height/width/maxWidth/maxHeight attrs are the sole mechanism now. `video-behaviour` renders its 6 boolean bases through the shared tiered BooleanResponsiveControl (promoted to src/components/), matching this block's existing Tablet/Mobile playback tiers. `overlay` paints via `.sgs-media-box::after`; render.php adds the `sgs-media-box` marker class to the figure wrapper whenever a box atom is declared and gates naked-mode off in that case, per `SGS_Media_Element::requires_box()`.

media.label: Media
media._note_css_element_resolves_to_wrapper: objectFit/objectPosition/opacity/boxShadow resolve css_element to wrapper in the DB, not media, despite this element being named media — CONFIRMED INTENTIONAL 2026-08-27. isWrapper:true routes them through check-element-manifest-conformance.js's native-fallback path (nativeSupportsPath, around line 225), which only ever resolves against the wrapper element. Do not change this to media.

caption.label: Caption
caption._note: captionColourGradient is the text-colour gradient sibling to captionColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's labelColour/labelColourGradient (D636 gap-closure). css:color was previously undeclared here even though render.php (step 8, `.sgs-media__caption`) already emits it — this attrMap entry documents the existing flat-colour path as well as adding the new gradient one.

attributes._comment_svgArtDirection: Per-device SVG SOURCE (Spec 35 Part D5). Type MATCHES the base attr (string) — a mismatched type is silently coerced to the default and the whole value is dropped. There is no *Desktop sibling: the unsuffixed `svgContent` above IS the desktop tier. An empty tier falls back UP (mobile -> tablet -> desktop) per D3, so a blank tier means 'use the one above', never 'render nothing'. Inline SVG is markup with no extra fetch, so tiers render as SIBLINGS toggled by scoped @media CSS (the images pattern), NOT the video runtime swap.
attributes._comment_videoArtDirection: Video-source art-direction tiers (2026-08-07, Bean-decided). Completes the VIDEO half: the image half already ships imageId/imageUrl tiers, and the playback-behaviour tiers (videoAutoplay* etc.) already exist. Unlike images, tiers here CANNOT be sibling elements toggled by CSS — three <video>s each begin fetching and three embeds each load a player — so the source is swapped by view.js, reusing sgs/hero's established data-src-desktop/tablet/mobile contract with the same upward fallback. The server still renders the DESKTOP source as real markup, so a no-JS visitor gets a working video. Bean chose to include YouTube/Vimeo (2026-08-07) with the trade-off stated: crossing a breakpoint mid-watch rebuilds the iframe and loses playback position. Each tier's embed URL is built from THAT tier's own playback flags, so a mobile tier that wants muted autoplay gets it.

videoAutoplayTablet._comment: Per-device playback-behaviour tiers (D-pending). null = inherit the tier above (Tablet inherits Desktop, Mobile inherits Tablet) — the framework's null-means-inherit convention, same as maxWidthTablet etc. Desktop has no *Desktop sibling; the unsuffixed attr above IS the desktop value.

imageDecorative._comment: Spec 35 T3.4 / Part C 'A11y/SEO as controls' + E6 — WCAG 2.1 AA 1.1.1 (Non-text Content): a purely decorative image must be hidden from assistive tech (empty alt + aria-hidden) rather than forcing the operator to leave alt blank and hope. Narrow v1 scope: sgs/media + sgs/decorative-image only. Renamed from imageIsDecorative to the {element}Decorative convention (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep S8, matching sgs/timeline's milestoneMediaDecorative).

attributes._comment_mediaSizing: C19 shared media-sizing panel (2026-08-27). Three-way mode picker (auto/height/ratio) that makes `height` (above) and `style.dimensions.aspectRatio` (native support) mutually exclusive instead of letting both be set at once. NO `default` key deliberately — a `"default": null` on a typed attribute 400s every SSR preview (memory `a-null-default-is-worse-than-no-default`); render.php + edit.js both derive an absent value the same way (ratio set -> ratio; else height set -> height; else auto), so existing/old content renders identically with no edit needed.

aspectRatio._comment: box-shape atom's own flat AspectRatio base (Wave 5b) — replaces the retired native style.dimensions.aspectRatio. Spaced canonical form e.g. '16 / 9'.

borderRadius._comment: box-shape atom's own desktop-tier corner-keyed radius ({topLeft,topRight,bottomLeft,bottomRight}) — replaces the retired native style.border.radius. borderRadiusTablet/Mobile below are the existing tier siblings, unchanged.

borderWidth._comment: box-shape atom's own 4-side box ({top,right,bottom,left}) — replaces the retired native __experimentalBorder width. Untiered — per-device border width is cancelled (CLAUDE.md 'Border controls').

overlayColour._comment: overlay atom's own attrs (Wave 5b) — paints via `.sgs-media-box::after`.
